experiments.purpose: Run the exact Deep D3QN seed-44 replication without authorizing tuning, additional replication, or final-holdout evaluation.

reference.description: Confirmed deterministic Deep D3QN seed-42 reference. Its maximum same-side-engine streak was 28. Benchmark A mean/solved was 274.5898 / 98%; Benchmark B mean/solved was 260.2707 / 94%.

screening_rule.description: Manual seed-44 replication gate and frozen-candidate decision. No result or threshold schedules another run.
manual_criteria: Replication requires either combined mean reward at least 242.929 with solved count at least 131/150, or solved count at least 142/150 with combined mean reward at least 235.929.
Replication additionally requires at most 1 negative episode, at most 3 timeouts, mean length at most 297.27, and maximum same-side-engine streak below 100.
Performance must remain acceptable on both Benchmark A and Benchmark B, and the primary-performance direction must confirm the seed-42 result.
A44 Vanilla reference: mean reward 237.929; solved 134/150 (89.33%); low 0/150; mean length 283.11; timeouts 1/150.

If seed 44 passes the declared replication gate, the archived Deep D3QN seed-44 checkpoint becomes the frozen final candidate regardless of whether its development-set metrics are higher or lower than seed 42.
The seed-42 and seed-44 Deep D3QN checkpoints must not be compared adaptively for final checkpoint selection.
If seed 44 fails the replication gate, retain the archived Vanilla A44 checkpoint.
No additional training, rescue, tuning, or replication is permitted after this result.
All screening and final-candidate decisions are manual; automatic follow-up is disabled.
